structure.description: Each row is one calendar date with parallel values for the coded market series; blank cells represent unavailable observations.

uncertainties: The exact instrument identities, field type, price-adjustment convention, quote currencies, and units are not defined by the table.
Trading-calendar and holiday handling are not documented.
annotation_notes: Series meanings remain code-based where train.csv provides no instrument legend.
